name.g: a name, kept as in the Hebrew

ra.g: to meet, befall, reach; (Pa'el) to call together, convene

kns.g: to gather; (Itpa'al) to be gathered together

shry.g: to dwell, rest; to begin; (Af'el) to settle, place

yy.g: Hashem — Onkelos writes יְיָ both for the Name and for אֱלֹהִים

rvrv.g: to be great, become a prince

yat.g: marks the direct object (= Hebrew אֶת)

qrb.g: to come near; (Pa'el) to bring near, touch

ry2.g: to be pleased with, desire, accept favorably

plh.g: to work, till; to serve, worship

qbl2.g: to receive, accept; (לְמֵימַר) to listen to

gly.g: to uncover, reveal; to go into exile; (passive participle) revealed, known

el.g: God (a Hebrew word kept by Onkelos in אֵל עִלָּאָה)

sar.g: to visit (punish); (Af'el) to bring (sins) to account

nht.g: to go down; (Af'el) to bring down

bza.g: to split; (Itpe'el) to be split open

kly.g: to hold back; (Itpe'el) to be withheld

tsna.g: to put away, store, lay aside

meimra.g: word; (of Hashem) His Word, the Memra

kft.g: to tie, bind; (of a tree) to bear (fruit)

mattara.g: charge, guard (נְטַר מַטְּרַת = kept the charge)

swf.g: to come to an end, be used up

prq.g: to redeem, rescue; to unload, take apart; (Itpe'el) to come loose

maa.g: ma'ah (a small coin; pl. מָעִין) (Hebrew: גֵּרָה)

asra.g: a tenth (חַד מִן עַסְרָא = a tithe)
